subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw extend the accepted FxTwitter MVP beyond single-tweet import, and if so which one deferred public-read surface should be approved first?
rationale: The owner deliberately limited the merged work because additional endpoints expand third-party disclosure, capability semantics, rate-limit behavior, persistence scope, and URL-security policy.

options.title: Stage one deferred surface
options.body: Approve one narrowly specified next capability, such as thread import or public profile lookup, while preserving the fixed origin and explicit per-invocation opt-in.

options.title: Keep the tweet-only boundary
options.body: Treat the merged single-tweet import as the complete FxTwitter scope for now and defer broader transport work indefinitely.

recommendation.title: Stage one deferred surface
recommendation.body: Approve one narrowly specified next capability, such as thread import or public profile lookup, while preserving the fixed origin and explicit per-invocation opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: They recorded the accepted MVP boundary and shipped the implementation that defines the current product direction.
